items.control_name: Enforce Public Access Prevention (PAP) on GCS Buckets
items.description: All Cloud Storage buckets must have Public Access Prevention set to 'enforced'.
items.current_value: 2 buckets with Public Access Prevention set to 'unspecified'
items.recommended_value: Public Access Prevention = 'enforced' across 100% of buckets

items.description: Prevent object-level ACLs by enforcing Uniform Bucket-Level Access.

items.control_name: Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) for Sensitive Datasets
items.description: BigQuery datasets and Cloud SQL instances containing PII/PCI must use Cloud KMS CMEK.
items.current_value: CMEK configured for BigQuery analytics; default Google encryption on Cloud SQL dev
items.recommended_value: CMEK enforced for Production Cloud SQL, BigQuery, and GCS buckets
items.evidence_source: gcloud kms keys list / Cloud SQL describe
items.remediation_notes: Verify KMS key rotation period is set to <= 90 days and separation of duties is maintained.

items.control_name: Enforce SSL/TLS Connections on Cloud SQL Instances
items.description: Cloud SQL instances must reject unencrypted connections (require_ssl = true).
items.current_value: SSL required on 4 of 4 Cloud SQL instances
items.remediation_notes: Ensure client certificates are rotated annually.
